schemeScope: Combined Ordinary scheme. nonPoolDecisions: Reading: all ten questions are required; each printed (a)/(b) part is a 5-mark practice card. “3 mharc + 2 mharc” items are order-dependent (first correct point 3, second 2) and stay whole at 0/3/5; single answers with a printed partial (“= 3 mharc”) allow 0/3/5, otherwise 0/5.
Reading language: “Gaeilge lochtach: 0 - 5 a bhaint den iomlán a gnóthaíodh” is one deduction from each 50-mark passage total; cards state it without applying it inside a part.

Prescribed prose (2A): Oisín i dTír na nÓg (a) prints five sub-questions the scheme prices at 5 each: the whole option is a 25-mark card and every sub-question is also a practice card (“3 mharc + 2 mharc” sub-questions keep 0/3/5). Hurlamaboc (b) and Dís (c) are one 25-mark question each (five points at 2 + 3).

Prescribed poetry (3A): each poem is a whole 25-mark card with (i) 8, (ii) 8, (iii) 9 and one 0–4 Gaeilge deduction; every printed sub-question is also a practice card. 3A(a)(i) An tEarrach Thiar and 3A(c)(ii) An Spailpín Fánach each print four 2-mark questions (a)–(d): the sub-question keeps 0/2/4/6/8 and each question is its own 2-mark practice card.

Literature mark values: literature sub-questions other than “3 mharc + 2 mharc” keep the full range because the scheme’s points are indicative and further relevant points are credited “de réir a bhfiúntais”.
Optional prose (2B) and optional poetry (3B) stay whole: the text is open content chosen by the candidate. 3B(b) asks for a modern poem not used in 3B(a), inside its own printed question.

Choose two of the literature options (two from one of 2A, 2B, 3A or 3B, or one prose and one poetry) is a choice, not a route: each printed option is its own card carrying “Freagair dhá cheist as an roinn seo.”; no combination cards.
sourceFindings: Paper 2 = 150 marks printed on the cover; Léamhthuiscint A 50 + B 50 (five questions of 10, each (a) 5 + (b) 5) and two literature questions at 25.
Reading A “Uimhir a Sé, Sráid Fhearchair, Baile Átha Cliath” (paper pages 4–5, scheme PDF 16–17) and B “An Ceol” (paper 6–7, scheme PDF 18–20).

Prescribed prose (paper 9): Oisín i dTír na nÓg (i)–(v) at 5 each; Hurlamaboc one 25-mark question; Dís one 25-mark question (five points at 2 + 3). Optional prose (paper 10): (a) folk tale 23 (5, 5, 5, 4, 4) + title 2; (b) novel extract naming 1 + 22 + title/author 2; (c) short story naming 1 + 22 + title/author 2.

Prescribed poetry (paper 11–13): An tEarrach Thiar ((i) four 2-mark questions, (ii) 8, (iii) 9), Colscaradh (8/8/9), An Spailpín Fánach ((i) 8, (ii) four 2-mark questions, (iii) 9). Optional poetry (paper 14): (a) modern 9 (5 + 4) / 7 (1 + 3 + 3) / 7 (1 + 3 + 3), (b) modern, not the 3B(a) poem, 9 (1 + 4 + 4) / 7 (1 + 3 + 3) / 7 (4 + 3), (c) pre-1850 9 (5 + 4) / 7 (1 + 3 + 3) / 7 (1 + 3 + 3), + 2 for poem and poet.

Literature language: “[Gaeilge lochtach: 0-4 a bhaint den iomlán a gnóthaíodh]” after every literature answer (Dís prints it with a closing full stop); it is a deduction from that answer, never inside one sub-question.

Scheme layout: the 2022 text layer stores the boxed headings (“CEIST 1 (A + B) - LÉAMHTHUISCINT - 100 marc”, “A – (50 marc)”, “B – (50 marc)”, “2A – PRÓS AINMNITHE”, “2B – PRÓS ROGHNACH”, “3A – FILÍOCHT AINMNITHE”, “3B – FILÍOCHT ROGHNACH”) with the page body; the builder removes those exact strings (seven) so none lands inside an answer key. SymbolMT bullets are repaired to •.

2022 prints no “Freagair 2A … nó 2B …” or “Freagair do rogha dhá cheann …” lines above the literature options: the choice is on the instructions page (PDF 3). Each section’s box heading, and for 2B and 3B the printed restriction, lead in to its cards.

Legacy corrections (IDs, totals and topics unchanged): each reading card had one undivided criterion; each literature option had one Eolas criterion with the legacy text. All now carry the lifted 2022 scheme text and per-part tariffs.
